Questions 27–30

Who is going to write each of the following parts of the report?

Write(drag) the correct letter, A-D, next to Questions 27-30.

27 how they planned the project

28 how they had ideas for their stories

29 an interpretation of their stories

30 comments on the illustrations

A Helen only
B Jeremy only
C both Helen and Jeremy
D neither Helen nor Jeremy

transcript.en: Hello, Helen. Sorry I'm late.
transcript.zh: Helen，你好，对不起，我迟到了。

transcript.en: Hi, Jeremy, no problem.
transcript.zh: 你好，Jeremy，没关系的

transcript.en: Well we'd better work out where we are on our project, I suppose.
transcript.zh: 我想我们最好确定一下这个课题我们进行到哪了。

transcript.en: Yeah. I've looked at the drawings you've done for my story, 'The Forest',
transcript.zh: 好的，我已经看过你为我的故事画的图了，叫'The Forest'对吧，

transcript.en: and I think they're brilliant - they really create the atmosphere I had in mind when I was writing it.
transcript.zh: 我觉得你画得特别棒，简直画出了我写这篇故事时脑子里浮现的场景。

transcript.en: I'm glad you like them.
transcript.zh: 你喜欢就好。

transcript.en: There are just a few suggestions I'd like to make.
transcript.zh: 不过我想给你提几个建议。

transcript.en: Go ahead.
transcript.zh: 尽管说就是了。

transcript.en: Now, I'm not sure about the drawing of the cave - it's got trees all around it, which is great,
transcript.zh: 我觉得关于洞穴的这幅画还有待改善，它四周都是树，这很好，

transcript.en: but the drawing's a bit too static, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 但是我觉得这幅画有点太静态了，你不觉得吗？

transcript.en: I think it needs some action.
transcript.zh: 我认为需要在里面加点动作。

transcript.en: Yes, there's nothing happening.
transcript.zh: 是啊，里面一点动静都没有。

transcript.en: Perhaps I should add the boy - Malcolm, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 也许我应该把那个小男孩也画进去，他叫Malcolm，对吧？

transcript.en: He would be walking up to it.
transcript.zh: 可以画成他正在走近那个洞穴。

transcript.en: Yes, let's have Malcolm in the drawing.
transcript.zh: 对，我们把Malcolm加进画里吧。

transcript.en: And what about putting in a tiger - the one that he makes friends with a bit later?
transcript.zh: 再多画一只老虎怎么样？就是那只稍后跟他成了朋友的老虎。

transcript.en: Maybe it could be sitting under a tree washing itself.
transcript.zh: 也许可以画成它正坐在一棵树下舔舐自己的毛发。

transcript.en: And the tiger stops in the middle of what it's doing when it sees Malcolm walking past.
transcript.zh: 而当这只老虎看见Malcolm走过时舔到一半就停了下来。

transcript.en: That's a good idea.
transcript.zh: 想法不错。

transcript.en: OK, I'll have a go at that.
transcript.zh: 好的，那我就试着画一下。

transcript.en: Then there's the drawing of the crowd of men and women dancing.
transcript.zh: 然后就是那幅一群男人和女人跳舞的插图。

transcript.en: They're just outside the forest, and there's a lot going on.
transcript.zh: 你画的只是他们在森林外面，但是实际上那是很热闹的。

transcript.en: That's right, you wanted them to be watching a carnival procession, but I thought it would be too crowded.
transcript.zh: 没错，你想要的是让他们观看一场狂欢节游行，但是我觉得那样画面就太拥挤了。

transcript.en: Do you think it works like this?
transcript.zh: 你觉得这样行吗？

transcript.en: Yes, I like what you've done.
transcript.zh: 行，我很喜欢你画的。

transcript.en: The only thing is, could you add Malcolm to it, without changing what's already there.
transcript.zh: 只有一点，你能不能把Malcolm也加进去？但是不要改变画面的现有布局。

transcript.en: What about having him sitting on the tree trunk on the right of the picture?
transcript.zh: 把他画成坐在画面右边的那棵树干上怎么样？

transcript.en: Yes, that would be fine.
transcript.zh: 嗯，可以啊。

transcript.en: And do you want him watching the other people?
transcript.zh: 你想要他看着其他人吗？

transcript.en: No, he's been left out of all the fun, so I'd like him to be crying - that'll contrast nicely with the next picture,
transcript.zh: 不，他被排除在了所有这些快乐之外，所以我希望你把他画成在哭的样子，这样就能和下一幅画形成鲜明的对比了，

transcript.en: where he's laughing at the clowns in the carnival.
transcript.zh: 下一幅画里他在狂欢节上被小丑表演逗得哈哈大笑。

transcript.en: Right, I'll do that.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会照着来的。

transcript.en: And then the drawing of the people ice skating in the forest.
transcript.zh: 还有那幅人们在森林里滑冰的画。

transcript.en: I wasn't too happy with that one.
transcript.zh: 我对那一幅也不是很满意。

transcript.en: Because they're supposed to be skating on grass, aren't they?
transcript.zh: 因为他们原本应该在草地上滑冰的，对吧？

transcript.en: That's right, and it's frozen over.
transcript.zh: 对，草地上全都结冰了。

transcript.en: At the moment it doesn't look quite right.
transcript.zh: 现在的画面看上去不是很对劲。

transcript.en: Mm, I see what you mean.
transcript.zh: 我知道你什么意思了。

transcript.en: I'll have another go at that.
transcript.zh: 我再重新画一幅试试。

transcript.en: And I like the wool hats they're wearing.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢他们戴的毡帽。

transcript.en: Maybe you could give each of them a scarf, as well.
transcript.zh: 也许你还可以给他们每个人再画条围巾。

transcript.en: Yeah, that's easy enough.
transcript.zh: 好的，小菜一碟。

transcript.en: They can be streaming out behind the people to suggest they're skating really fast.
transcript.zh: 围巾在人们身后飘逸，这样就能显出他们滑冰的速度很快了。

transcript.en: Mm, great.
transcript.zh: 嗯，太棒了。

transcript.en: Well that's all on the drawings.
transcript.zh: 那在插图方面就只有这些问题了。

transcript.en: Right. So you've finished writing your story and I just need to finish illustrating it, and my story and your drawings are done.
transcript.zh: 好的，也就是说你已经把你的故事写完了，只需要我把插图画完就可以了，而且我的故事和你的插图已经完成了。

transcript.en: So the next thing is to decide what exactly we need to write about in the report that goes with the stories,
transcript.zh: 那接下来的事情就是决定我们究竟要在跟故事一起交的报告里写什么了，

transcript.en: and how we're going to divide the work.
transcript.zh: 以及如何分工。

transcript.en: Right, Helen.
transcript.zh: 没错，Helen。

transcript.en: What do you think about including a section on how we planned the project as a whole, Jeremy?
transcript.zh: Jeremy，你觉得以我们一起策划这个课题的始末为内容写一个章节怎么样？

transcript.en: That's probably quite important.
transcript.zh: 那部分内容可能相当重要。

transcript.en: Yeah. Well, you've had most of the good ideas so far.
transcript.zh: 对，到目前为止大部分好想法都是你提出来的。

transcript.en: How do you feel about drafting something, then we can go through it together and discuss it?
transcript.zh: 你觉得先写个草稿怎么样？然后我们就可以一起过一遍，再讨论一下。

transcript.en: OK, that seems reasonable.
transcript.zh: 好啊，似乎蛮合理的。

transcript.en: And I could include something on how we came up with the ideas for our two stories, couldn't I?
transcript.zh: 我还可以把我们是如何想出来这两个故事的包括在内，对吧？

transcript.en: Well I've started writing something about that, so why don't you do the same and we can include the two things.
transcript.zh: 我已经开始写了一点关于这方面的东西，所以你不妨也这么做，然后我们可以把这两个都列进去。

transcript.en: Right. So what about our interpretation of the stories?
transcript.zh: 好的，那我们对这些故事的说明呢？

transcript.en: Do we need to write about what we think they show, like the value of helping other people, all that sort of thing?
transcript.zh: 我们要写一下我们认为它们表达了什么东西吗？像应该乐于助人这样的价值观之类的。

transcript.en: That's going to come up later, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 这个稍后再讲，对吧?

transcript.en: I think everyone in the class is going to read each other's stories and come up with their own interpretations, which we're going to discuss.
transcript.zh: 我记得应该是班上每个人要先读一读彼此的故事，然后再提出他们对自己故事的说明以供我们讨论。

transcript.en: Oh, I missed that.
transcript.zh: 啊，我没听到那个要求。

transcript.en: So it isn't going to be part of the report at all?
transcript.zh: 那根本不用把它包括在报告里了？

transcript.en: No. But we need to write about the illustrations, because they're an essential element of children's experience of reading the stories.
transcript.zh: 不用，但是我们需要把图示写出来，因为它们在孩子们对这些故事的阅读体验方面是很重要的一环。

transcript.en: It's probably easiest for you to write that section, as you know more about drawing than I do.
transcript.zh: 因为你对画画了解得比我要多，所以你来写这部分内容可能最简单不过了。

transcript.en: Maybe, but I find it quite hard to write about.
transcript.zh: 也许吧，但是我觉得这部分很难写啊。

transcript.en: I'd be happier if you did it.
transcript.zh: 如果你来写的话我会更开心。

transcript.en: OK. So when do you think...
transcript.zh: 好吧，那你觉得什么时候...
